name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents; local compatibility fixes preserve @xzzpig/pi-permission-system priority in resolvePermissionSystemExtension() (now in src/runs/shared/child-tool-plan.ts). Fleet native transcript (openspec fleet-native-transcript): src/tui/fleet-native-transcript.ts (JSONL→shared-library entries adapter + Pi-native renderer via guarded dynamic import of @xzzpig/pi-components/transcript), wiring in src/tui/fleet.ts (renderer mode cache branch, v/V toggleRenderer keybinding, legacy fallback), @xzzpig/pi-components bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published), and shared readTranscriptRecords export in src/tui/fleet-transcript.ts. Fork-only additions: context injection (src/extension/context-injection.ts, injectToContext frontmatter field, subagents.injectAgents setting, doctor reporting) and the shared agent-eject API (src/api/agent-management.ts, ejectAgentDefinition) used by pi-goal-x. The old Pi SDK streamFn option-naming divergence was dropped: upstream ships agentStreamOptions() dual-name handling.
